papers.title: Prevalence of protective hepatitis B surface antibody levels and associated factors among women admitted for delivery at Kawempe National Referral Hospital, Uganda: A cross-sectional study

findings.sentence: For the prevalence of protective anti-HBs levels, Kish's formula [22], n = Z²p(1 -p)/d², with an assumed non-protective prevalence of 22.9% as used in a previous Ugandan study [20], Z = 1.96 and a precision (d) of 5%, gave a minimum of 272 participants. For the analysis of associated factors, a sample size for comparing two proportions computed in G*Power (two-sided α 0.05, 80% power, expected proportions 0.192 and 0.052) gave 383 participants. The larger requirement was adopted, and the enrolment target was set at 420 to allow for incomplete questionnaires or unusable samples.

papers.title: Effects of Sacred Dances versus Conventional Physical Training on Functional Capacity and Quality of Life in Women with Heart Failure: Protocol for a Randomized Active-Controlled Crossover Non-Inferiority Trial (RED-WHF)

findings.sentence: Assuming a one-sided significance level (α) of 2.5% and statistical power (1-β) of 80%, the formula for two-period crossover non-inferiority comparison [n = ((z₁₋α + z₁₋β)² × σd²) / Δ²] yielded a minimum sample size of 22 participants. To account for a potential 10% dropout rate, the sample size was expanded to 30 participants. Sample size parameters and power estimations were verified using R statistical software (pwr / TrialSize packages). papers.title: Antifolate resistance markers and complexity of infection in children with sickle cell anaemia receiving malaria chemoprevention in Uganda: a molecular sub-study of the CHEMCHA randomised trial

findings.sentence: The sample size for the parent trial was calculated to provide 90% power (two-sided α=0.05) to detect a 50% reduction in the incidence of clinical malaria, from an assumed 0.2 episodes per person-year in the SP arm to 0.1 episodes per person-year in the DP arm [11]. This required 824 person-years of follow-up in approximately 548 participants [10]. Because this was a secondary analysis of malaria parasites collected within the trial, no separate sample size calculation was performed; instead, all malaria-positive samples on microscopy were included.
findings.note: Not found: the statistical test, the sample size, the alpha level, the power, the effect size, the effect size metric, the software.

papers.title: Mucin VNTR haplogroup associations with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis are not independent of rs35705950

findings.sentence: Cluster-wide scan of imputed structural variants 11p15.5 contains repeat and structural variation that haplogroup tagging cannot reach, including the MUC2 VNTR domain. We therefore asked whether any common, well-imputed VNTR or structural-variant allele across the cluster (109 variants) is associated with IPF independently of rs35705950, recognising that this sample can only detect large effects.
